verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Recurly offers merchant- and API-side subscription changes (upgrade, downgrade, add-ons, proration), plus an Engage 'Cancel/Save' retention survey. Neither documents a customer-facing hosted portal or embeddable components that let subscribers upgrade, downgrade, or cancel on their own. These are developer building blocks and an adjacent retention feature, not the self-service capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
